name: USM-AA
description: A genomic foundation model that uses an alignment embedding module and alignment-aware rotary position embedding to place tokens of a transformer encoder on reference genome coordinates, so non-contiguous inputs keep their positions.

attributes.access: Source code at https://github.com/Jimmy0743/USM-AA; pretrained weights are linked from Google Drive via models/download.sh (README, Download Pretrained Models).
